audit_result.proof_trace: Both `handle_debt_auto_deleverage` (ADLBorrow) and `handle_collateral_auto_deleverage` (ADLCollateral) delegate to the same `liquidation_inner`, which unconditionally calls `obligation.withdraw_ctokens(seized_ctokens)` at L776—seizing collateral regardless of which ADL path triggered it. There is no conditional branch in `liquidation_inner` to skip collateral seizure for the debt ADL path, directly violating the spec invariant INV-003 (SG-010) and the property assertion `collateral_after == collateral_before`.
audit_result.attack_scenario: When the ADL system activates borrow deleverage (total borrows exceed threshold), an ADL keeper holding a `PackageCallerCap` with adl() permission calls `liquidate_adl_borrow`, which repays the obligation's debt AND seizes collateral (plus liquidation incentive) via `liquidation_inner::L776`. Obligation holders lose collateral unexpectedly beyond the protocol's stated guarantee that ADLBorrow only reduces debt.

PROP-current-fina-inv-027.text: ADLBorrow must reduce obligation debt without seizing proportional collateral.
PROP-current-fina-inv-027.assertion: forall adl_borrow(obligation): debt_after < debt_before && collateral_after == collateral_before
